message: Cannot apply the aspect '{0}' to '{1}': the template returns '{2}', of type '{3}', from a method or local function whose return type is '{4}'.
title: A template cannot return a void expression from a method or local function that has a non-void return type.
rationale: The only report site (TemplateExpansionContext.CreateReturnStatement) fires when a returned expression of type void meets a non-void return type of the enclosing local function or template method; 'the desired type' does not tell the reader that '{4}' is this return type. The title names only the Proceed method, although any void expression triggers it, and has no final period.
